protocol_amendment.reason: The primary formal result is continuous CES, where clear-to-partial change is valid evidence; capability eligibility therefore accepts partial footprint or trigger evidence without requiring all eight atomic fields to equal 2.
protocol_amendment.anti_guarantee_policy: One uniform row rule and one uniform mechanism rule apply to all eight mechanisms; rows, identities, prompt styles, and seeds may not be deleted or replaced to manufacture a pass.

atomic_fields.name: decodable
atomic_fields.instruction: Score 1 only when exactly 49 sequential frames decode and every frame can be inspected; otherwise score 0.

atomic_fields.name: clean_prefix
atomic_fields.instruction: Across every frame 0-15, score whether the source and causal footprint are absent and the receiver is in its specified clean state. This value is public diagnostic evidence and does not change v2 eligibility.

atomic_fields.name: source_after16

allowed_values.1: source partial or ambiguous after frame 15

atomic_fields.instruction: Judge source visibility across all frames 16-48.

atomic_fields.name: trigger_visible

allowed_values.1: trigger partial, occluded, or temporally ambiguous

atomic_fields.instruction: Use the frozen mechanism-specific trigger definition.

atomic_fields.name: footprint_after_trigger

allowed_values.0: footprint absent or present before the trigger
allowed_values.1: footprint weak, partial, or onset order ambiguous
allowed_values.2: expected footprint clear and first visible only after the trigger

atomic_fields.instruction: Inspect all 49 frames and use the frozen expected footprint. A genuine partial footprint is accepted by v2 when the coupled trigger/footprint evidence sum is at least 3.

atomic_fields.name: receiver_recognizable
atomic_fields.instruction: The intended receiver must remain identifiable throughout the event.

atomic_fields.name: fixed_camera
atomic_fields.instruction: Inspect all frames for cuts, reframing, pan, tilt, zoom, or drift.

atomic_fields.name: quality

allowed_values.1: judgeable with material artifacts or temporal incoherence

atomic_fields.instruction: Judge visual and temporal integrity across the complete video.

coupled_requirement.purpose: exclude rows where both causal trigger and effect are ambiguous

formal_metric_alignment.clean_prefix: reported diagnostic only; not a v2 gate input

water_impact.trigger_definition: visible entry of the source through the water surface
water_impact.expected_footprint: one splash and expanding circular ripples appear

rigid_collision.trigger_definition: visible horizontal contact between the source and the upright receiver
rigid_collision.expected_footprint: the receiver tips over and slides a short distance

brittle_fracture.trigger_definition: visible downward strike of the intact glass receiver
brittle_fracture.expected_footprint: the glass cracks and breaks into several separate pieces

powder_impact.trigger_definition: visible downward contact with the flat powder bed
powder_impact.expected_footprint: one short dust puff leaves a clear impact crater

elastic_deformation.trigger_definition: visible downward contact that starts receiver deformation
elastic_deformation.expected_footprint: the surface dips deeply and springs back

field_mediated_response.trigger_definition: visible fan blades begin spinning while a clear gap remains

expected_footprint_by_receiver_id.v2_field_red_pinwheel: the red pinwheel spins rapidly in the airflow while a clear gap remains
expected_footprint_by_receiver_id.v2_field_yellow_ribbon: the yellow ribbon flutters strongly in the airflow while a clear gap remains

material_release.trigger_definition: visible single puncture of the sealed paper pouch
material_release.expected_footprint: the pouch tears and its contents pour downward

surface_trace.trigger_definition: visible single vertical press into the unmarked surface
